# Beyond Visibility

> Grades a live URL for how likely AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews) are to retrieve and parse it. The Technical Grader scores a Technical Score across 5 categories (schema, AI crawler access, metadata, freshness, extractability) — deterministic checks, no model call. A standalone Content Grader, scoring the writing itself (AI Answerability, Structure & Chunking, Citations, and more — 7 categories) for pasted text or an uploaded file, is coming back soon.

## Pages

- [Home](https://beyondvisibility.live/): Product overview, the Technical Grader, and how the score is calculated.
- [101](https://beyondvisibility.live/101): What AEO and AISO mean, how they evolved from SEO, how an answer engine's retrieval pipeline actually works, and the exact rubric weights behind every score.
